about: Client Connector installers the pilot-device setup downloads, pinned by SHA-256. They live on this repository's zcc-installer pre-release (the zcc-installer workflow copies each 'source' there and checks the hash). The setup scripts install a file only if its SHA-256 matches and it carries a valid Zscaler, Inc. signature. To change versions: update an entry here (file, version, sha256, source) and push; the workflow attaches the new file. 'source' may be empty if the file was attached to the pre-release by hand.
